scheme_name: Sikkim Garib Thekka Incentive Scheme (Production Incentive Scheme)
description: Provides direct financial cash incentives to local organic farmers based on the quantity of certified organic crops produced and sold through formal channels to boost rural incomes.
benefits: Direct cash incentive paid per kilogram for major crops like Large Cardamom (₹100/kg), Ginger (₹20/kg), Turmeric (₹10/kg), Buckwheat (₹10/kg), and Milk (₹8/liter).
eligibility: Organic farmers residing in Sikkim selling produce through recognized cooperatives, FPOs, or government procurement centers
Must hold Sikkim Subject Certificate / Certificate of Identification (CoI)
documents: Sikkim Subject Certificate / Certificate of Identification (CoI)
Produce Sale Receipt from FPO / Cooperative
application_mode: Offline via District Horticulture / Agriculture Extension Officer or Local FPO

scheme_name: Sikkim Organic Mission & NPOP/PGS Certification Scheme
description: Maintains and expands Sikkim's status as India's 100% organic state by funding organic inputs, bio-pesticides, soil testing, and free organic re-certification.
benefits: Free supply of certified bio-fertilizers and bio-pesticides, zero-cost third-party NPOP/PGS organic certification, and training on vermicomposting.
eligibility: All practicing farmers and landholders operating agricultural land in Sikkim
application_mode: Offline via Block Agriculture Development Officer (ADO) / Sikkim Organic Mission Office

description: Supports commercial greenhouse cultivation of high-value orchids (Cymbidium), Gerbera, Rose, and off-season organic vegetables tailored for hill climates.
benefits: 50% to 75% capital subsidy for installing polyhouses, shade-net structures, drip irrigation systems, and purchasing disease-free tissue culture plantlets.
eligibility: Horticulture growers and registered SHGs in Sikkim with suitable land terrace access
application_mode: Offline via District Horticulture Officer (DHO) / Horticulture Department

description: Aims to restore and expand high-yielding Large Cardamom plantations across hill districts by replacing disease-affected old bushes with certified virus-free suckers.
benefits: Financial assistance of up to ₹70,000 per hectare for trench digging, certified disease-free suckers, organic inputs, and eco-friendly cardamom curing kilns (Bhatti).
eligibility: Traditional cardamom growers and landowners in Sikkim
application_mode: Offline via District Horticulture Office / Spices Board Local Office

description: Provides financial subsidies on power tillers, brush cutters, mini-paddy threshers, and power weeders engineered specifically for terrace farming in mountain terrain.
benefits: 50% to 80% subsidy for individual smallholders and up to 80% subsidy for establishing Custom Hiring Centers (CHCs) operated by SHGs/Cooperatives.
eligibility: Farmers owning or cultivating land in Sikkim, registered SHGs, and cooperatives
application_mode: Online via Agmachinery Portal / Offline via District Agriculture Officer

scheme_name: Chief Minister’s Livestock Development Incentive Scheme
description: Promotes high-yielding dairy farming, goat rearing, and backyard piggery by providing cattle purchase grants and milk production bonuses.
benefits: Direct cash bonus of ₹8 per liter of milk delivered to dairy cooperatives, 50% subsidy on buying crossbred cows/pigs, and free artificial insemination/vaccination.
eligibility: Livestock farmers and rural households in Sikkim holding CoI / Resident Proof
application_mode: Offline via District Animal Husbandry Officer / Local Dairy Cooperative Society

scheme_name: Sikkim Trout Culture & Cold-Water Fisheries Mission
description: Leverages cold freshwater mountain streams to promote high-value Rainbow Trout culture and carp farming in raceways and tanks.
benefits: 60% financial subsidy for constructing concrete trout raceways, purchasing high-quality trout ova/fingerlings, and specialized floating fish feed.
eligibility: Landholders and mountain farmers in Sikkim with access to perennial cold-water streams
application_mode: Offline via Directorate of Fisheries / District Fisheries Officer

scheme_name: PM-KUSUM Off-Grid Solar Pumping Scheme (Sikkim Component)
description: Installs standalone solar-powered water pumpsets on remote mountain slopes where regular electricity grid connections are inaccessible.
benefits: Up to 85% combined central and state financial subsidy on standalone solar water pumpsets (2 HP to 5 HP).
eligibility: Farmers owning land in Sikkim with access to surface water sources (springs/rivers) lacking electricity grid power
application_mode: Offline via SREDA (Sikkim Renewable Energy Development Agency) / District Agriculture Office

scheme_name: Sikkim Buckwheat & Traditional Crop Revival Scheme
description: Encourages cultivation of traditional climate-resilient crops like Buckwheat (Mithey/Titey Phaper), Finger Millet, and Native Beans to enhance nutritional security and soil health.
benefits: Free distribution of high-quality seeds, ₹10,000 per hectare incentive for traditional crop cultivation, and guaranteed state marketing support.
eligibility: Farmers cultivating indigenous crops in hill areas of Sikkim
application_mode: Offline via Block Agriculture Development Office

scheme_name: Terrace Land Development & Spring-Shed Rejuvenation Scheme
description: Provides financial and technical support for bench terracing, contour stone bunding, and recharging dried-up mountain springs (Dhars) for year-round agricultural water.
benefits: Financial grant up to ₹30,000 per hectare for bench terrace construction and spring-shed recharge structure building.
eligibility: Farmers practicing hill slope agriculture in Sikkim
application_mode: Offline via District Water Resources / Soil Conservation Department
